title: Compatibility Purchase Coordinator Input
description: SDK-local input for redeeming a deprecated products_available legacy_create continuation. This object is consumed by the compatibility coordinator and MUST NOT be sent as an AdCP tool payload. The coordinator validates it, then constructs and validates create_media_buy for the negotiated source version.

idempotency_key.description: Replay identity for this logical coordinator operation. Exact retries resume the durable operation record instead of redeeming the continuation again.

account.description: Account identity that must match the account bound into the continuation token.

selected_product_ids.description: Non-empty subset of the product IDs bound into the continuation.

accepted_losses.description: Exact loss set returned with the continuation. Missing, extra, or stale consent fails before mutation.

legacy_create_request.description: Proposed create_media_buy payload. Before mutation the coordinator validates this object against create-media-buy-request.json from source_adcp_version, requires explicit-package mode, and requires its package product IDs to equal selected_product_ids.

verifier_constraints.token_binding: Resolve continuation_token under the authenticated principal and require its account, expiry, complete observed product/pricing payload, and source version to match the durable record.
verifier_constraints.selection_binding: selected_product_ids is a non-empty subset of the token-bound product IDs and equals the distinct legacy_create_request package product IDs.
verifier_constraints.request_account_binding: For source versions whose create_media_buy request carries account, its normalized account identity equals both the top-level account and the token-bound account. For 2.5, which has no wire account field, the coordinator uses the same token-bound client/account session and MUST NOT retarget the seller connection.
verifier_constraints.loss_acceptance: accepted_losses equals the complete loss set returned with the continuation; subset, superset, or stale acceptance fails before mutation.
verifier_constraints.single_use: Atomically claim the token at the first mutation. Exact idempotency retries resume the same operation; a different operation cannot redeem a claimed token.
verifier_constraints.source_validation: legacy_create_request validates against the exact create-media-buy-request schema for source_adcp_version and uses explicit-package mode only.
